notes.title: Shale: Version 0.4
notes.content:
[h2]0.4 Update Notes[/h2]

[h3]Skill Points[/h3]
With this update I've finished off the levelling and skill system. Now once you level up or collect enough Shale (only by pickup), you'll be given a skill point which you can apply at your car. This process requires you to have at least 50 Shale and 1 skill point so you can generate your options and spending 50 Shale each time if you want to roll again. I've also added more options to choose from now including damage resistances, dodge cool-down, crafting XP boost and more. This point system has a maximum of 250 which eventually maxes out all stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/50f4ed008474b1978485cc744595408627c7e6b0.png[/img]

[h3]New Loot[/h3]
This update I've included some rare loot which can be crafted into expensive items that the player can sell. The full list is below but the main 3 items are a Generator, Lighter and Water Filter. You can also see the benefits of crafting and selling these as they'll help with costs for fusing items and generating skill options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/c590b0116d1a87c127b73017baf3d8ad7cbc7c5d.png[/img]

[h3]Getting Started[/h3]
I've improved the getting started screen to hopefully give a better introduction for new players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/dd05a750e516df90f26cf0e79082600eec16abc8.png[/img]

[h3]Additional Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Level cap increased to 35
[*]3 new enemies for level 35
[*]2 new tapes to collect
[*]1 new note to collect
[*]New weapon, car, character and backpack tints
[*]New character, backpack, weapon, head, and wheel models to unlock
[*]Junker walk animation improvements
[*]Audio improvements and weapon balancing
[*]Main screen improvements
[/list]

Feel free to jump in, try the update, and let me know what you think! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Shale: Version 0.22
notes.content:
[h2]0.22 Update Notes[/h2]

[h3]NPCs[/h3]
New NPCs, friendly "Junkers" will now spawn around the map and the starting location. You will be able to trade with some of them. These traders will have 3 items (1 health, 1 junk, 1 weapon or armor) to trade but will also have a chance to drop a rare "Set" item that you can purchase for a low price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/a791390e734cce45e9f229019f4823f4d8087214.png[/img]

[h3]Alt-Fire[/h3]
Every "Barrel" weapon part has an Alt-Fire ammo type. You will now be able to use Explosive, Fire, Oil or Acid. But be careful as particular enemies are totally immune to certain ammo types and damage over time effects do not stack (Current enemies are immune to Acid and Oil).
[list]
[*]Explosive - Base damage
[*]Fire - Base damage + damage over time
[*]Acid - Base damage + damage over time
[*]Oil - Base damage + slow effect
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/cd89fab0293f9a6a32f78d567d5482ab148efff3.png[/img]

[h3]Re-spawn[/h3]
Introduced a new spirit effect that guides you to each orb. The orb pickup count has now been reduced to 2 while the spawn distance has been increased slightly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/278af5383f26c0e3dea120c4105401be9cd003b4.png[/img]

[h3]Traps[/h3]
All traps are now clearly visible before being triggered. The trap trigger radius for the pillars and quick enemies has been increased to allow for more reaction time.

[h3]Dodging[/h3]
Cool-down time has been reduced to 4 seconds and dodging now pushes away particular enemies that move to the player.

[h3]Loot[/h3]
Added 3 new junk loot items with high value and rare drop chance. For now they are just items you can sell but they will eventually have a greater purpose. More items like these will be added in the future.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Current "Possessed" Level 5 enemy visual design change.
[*]Boss "Puzzle" input acceptance tolerance and trigger time increased.
[*]Fixed bug with client player models not replicating on death.
[*]Fixed bug with client player not dodging sometimes.
[*]Improved grenade hit function.
[*]Added some lighting to player car interior.
[*]Added right-click function on inventory items for quick sell/transfer.
[*]Increased reticle visibility across all levels and lighting scenarios.
[*]Moved player camera back slightly.
[/list]

Feel free to jump in, try the update, and let me know what you think! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Shale: Version 0.21
notes.content:
Early Access is now live for Shale!

With this initial 0.21 release I've added another boss at level 20. I've also added new fire modes for the receiver weapon part. Now there are semi-auto and burst fire modes via trading, looting or crafting and full-auto mode via the upgrade vendor. Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/e7f86d9a7a1e060a69e42ac6a89ccd1d290bc2d5.png[/img]

Just want to say thanks to all of you that played Shale until now and have given me some great feedback on your experience with it. I've put together the high level basic road-map for Shale and the biggest content updates I am planning for it. Of course this doesn't include patches, minor updates, improvements, changes and hot-fixes but I hope it gives a good idea as to where I'd like Shale to be at for 1.0 release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44016539/163e17dbef2499d31c16574961e2fadb2cf98fdb.png[/img]

I'll make this road-map available in-game and in discord as well for anyone that misses it. Also if you have any questions about the road-map or Shale, feel free to post it here or on the Discord. I'm happy to discuss anything about the game. ːsteamthumbsupː

Thank you! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Shale: Upcoming Public Test
notes.content:
As I'm getting ready to release Shale into Early Access, I'm having an open public playtest coming up on the 5th of July that will be available for one week!

This will be Version 0.2

At this point the game will feel a bit repetitive and slow with variety, but so far it currently has a level cap of 25, 7 enemy types, 2 bosses, trading, crafting and more.

The game is still missing a lot of content which I will be adding during the Early Access lifecycle which will include new locations, encounters, two more enemy factions, NPCs, skins, unlocks, damage effects, a lot of enemies, a lot of bosses, level variety and much more. A full development roadmap will be included with Early Access.

The first Early Access Release v0.21 will include another boss, weapon burst and full auto modes. The level cap will stay at 25 but will go up during future updates until the final cap of at least 100.

If you have any questions, feedback or want to join the discord, check out the links below. I'll be doing my absolute best to deliver the game I have planned.

notes.title: Shale: Prologue
notes.content:
Now that Next Fest is over, I want to thank everyone that played Shale. All of the feedback and videos of gameplay will greatly help me in choosing the right direction to refine and update Shale to be a much better experience. Although it's still very early in development and I need to put a lot more work into this, it's good to see both negative and positive responses from everyone. ːsteamthumbsupː

For anyone new dropping by, the current technical demo will be available until February 26th. This will allow anyone who missed it or want to try it out again to be able to play it. Again, as this is a technical demo, I will greatly appreciate all feedback from players. So if you find any bugs, have any issues or even just want to share how you felt after playing it, let me know! I will read all feedback and responses on the Shale Forums here on Steam as well as scavenge through YouTube to find any videos of gameplay. ːsteammockingː

The next step will be getting the Pre-Alpha version ready for public testing. Once that is over I will follow it up with getting ready for Alpha and Early Access. If you have any questions about Shale feel free to post in the discussions board and I'll do my best to answer you!

Follow the forums for all feedback and discussions
